description: Generic text section with an optional image. Supports three layout variants: text only, image left, image right.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Section heading. Omit to render the body without a heading.

body.description: HTML body content. Passed through wp_kses_post().

image_url.description: Image URL. Required for image-left and image-right layouts; ignored in text-only.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the image. Use empty string for decorative images.

layout.description: Column layout. 'centered' centers text with no image (image_url suppressed). Falls back to text-only if image_url is empty for image layouts.

variant.description: Background presentation. 'default' = page background. 'dark' = dark surface. 'inverted' = inverted background for strong contrast. Controls per-section visual rhythm on marketing pages.

background_image.description: Optional background image URL. When set, renders as a CSS background-image with a dark overlay for text readability. Combines with any variant. Text automatically uses light colors for contrast.

spacing.description: Vertical padding override. 'compact' tightens padding. 'spacious' adds extra breathing room. 'default' uses the component's built-in padding (subject to CSS rhythm defaults).

width.description: Content width override. 'narrow' constrains to 56rem. 'full' stretches to viewport (with padding). 'default' uses the standard max-width.
